leakageControls: All labels are public and must not be reported as protected-holdout evidence.
Captured reports and implementation output are not copied into this oracle.
Outcome changes require fixture and rule-contract review and are not made only to satisfy current output.

failurePrecision.numerator: emitted failures matching reviewed failed results

caseCoverage.numerator: managed cases executed through the public workflow

abstentionCoverage.numerator: reviewed cantTell, inapplicable, or untested results matched
abstentionCoverage.denominator: all reviewed cantTell, inapplicable, or untested results

falsePositives.numerator: emitted failed results absent from the corresponding reviewed oracle

mutationKillRate.numerator: reviewed targeted mutations producing their named failed result

hardNegativeFailures.numerator: emitted failures in reviewed hard-negative cases

cases.falsePositiveRisk: Using viewport bounds as document bounds or inferring peer membership from repeated visual cards would create unsupported failures.
cases.nonClaim: Zero failures means no current rule has sufficient evidence to fail this case; it is not a general UI or UX pass.

review.rationale: The managed clean state has no declared peer relation and no reviewed defect for the current rules.

cases.falsePositiveRisk: An absent inferred name is not enough; this case fails only because the observed native accessibility button has no programmatic name.
cases.nonClaim: The advisory result checks one selected control and is not a complete accessibility or WCAG audit.

review.rationale: The targeted source mutation removes only the help button aria-label while preserving its observed native role and interaction evidence.

cases.falsePositiveRisk: Treating every center-point obstruction as a defect would falsely fail valid dialogs, popovers, and other intentional overlays.
cases.nonClaim: The hard negative protects one declared overlay and does not establish broad overlay precision.

review.rationale: Native dialog semantics and source-reviewed intent make failure unsupported, while the exact center sample remains conflicting evidence and therefore cantTell.

nonClaims: One public targeted failure is too small a denominator for a representative precision estimate.
The corpus is one fictional application family and is not protected holdout data.
Successful current-rule outcomes do not establish general UI quality, UX quality, or WCAG conformance.
No result in this oracle changes advisory enforcement or blocking maturity.
